name: focus_neg_pool_climb
about: Swim west and jump against the wall of a pool at negative x whose rim block (-21, 64) holds water. 1.7.10 isAnyLiquid also scans the column x - 1 for negative minX, sees the rim water and refuses the 0.3 wall-climb boost; 1.8.9 does not scan it. Compare motionY per tick.
